New Episode – The Mysterious Cargo

French authorities warned Germany about a mysterious cargo shipment heading into German territory. Its contents were unknown. The German Chief of Security ordered a joint operation involving SEK and KSK units.

The port was placed under surveillance, but by the time the cargo ship was intercepted, it was already too late. The shipment had reached Hamburg. German Civil Police began tracking the truck, while local police attempted to stop it. Shortly after the truck was stopped, it was remotely detonated, releasing poisonous gas. Many people lost their lives.

Search and rescue teams and emergency decontamination units were dispatched. But new intelligence changed everything:

IT WAS A TRAP! Hamburg's defenses had been weakened, and the city was now facing a major threat.
